senses.gloss:
ग्लै €1 P. (ग्लायति, ग्लान)
—1 To feel aversion or dislike, be unwilling or disinclined to do anything (with inf.).
—2 To be fatigued or wearied, feel tired or exhausted.
—3 To despond, sink in spirit, be dejected; नाऽवकल्प्यमिदं ग्लायेद्
 यत् कृच्छ्रेषु भवानपि Bk. 19. 17, 6. 12.
—4 To wane, fade, faint away. ━Caus. (ग्ल-ग्लपयति, but प्रग्लापयति)
—1 To cause to fade away, wither up; ग्लपयति यथा शशाङ्कं न तथा
 हि कुमुद्वतीं दिवसः Ś. 3. 16; Ku. 3. 49.
—2 To tire out, exhaust.
—3 To injure, trouble, hurt.
—4 To emaciate, waste; व्रतैः स्वमङ्गं ग्लपयन्त्यहर्निशम् Ku. 5. 29; U. 3. 5.
